# Awesome Token Minimalism

> Minimal in, minimal out, minimal forever. Papers, tools, and patterns for spending fewer tokens on all three sides of an LLM call, with an evidence grade on every entry.

Start with [the three legs](README.md#the-three-legs) — input, output, lifetime — and [what counts as bloat](README.md#what-counts-as-bloat): the enemy is an unmeasured cost, never a capability.

## Always loaded

- [Awesome Token Minimalism](README.md): the list proper, and the index for the rest.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): the grade vocabulary and the additive clause.

## On demand

- [Anti-patterns](ANTI-PATTERNS.md): nineteen defaults that shipped unmeasured, each with a receipt.
- [Open problems](OPEN-PROBLEMS.md): what nobody has measured.
- [Token Maxxing](TOKENMAXXING.md): the negative-result catalog — the blow-ups, with their numbers.
- [Glossary](GLOSSARY.md): every load-bearing term, defined once.
- [Resources](RESOURCES.md): external frameworks, essays, and analysis.
- [Showcase](SHOWCASE.md): for maintainers submitting their own tool.

## Measure it yourself

- [Submit a measurement](harness/docs/submit-a-run.md): the runbook for a number that survives review.
- [token-harness](harness/README.md): the paired A/B rig this repo ships.
- [Leaderboard](harness/LEADERBOARD.md): measured results, grouped by harness — never compare across groups.
- [Pinned CLI output format](harness/docs/copilot-cli-format.md): the format the full-agent-loop executor depends on, version-pinned so breakage is detectable.
- [Entry index](entries.jsonl): name, URL, section, grade, and date for every graded entry — the qualification pass without reading the list. Generated from the README and gated in CI.
